text: 7-year-old boy. The patient has been experiencing recurrent episodes lasting 3–4 minutes each of facial grimacing and staring over the past month. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Absence Seizures (Childhood Absence Epilepsy).

The reported 3-4 minute duration and post-ictal confusion are more characteristic of complex partial seizures (temporal lobe epilepsy) or focal impaired awareness seizures with automatisms, rather than typical 10-15 second absence seizures. I would like to confirm the frequency and any potential triggers before finalizing this.
